<h1>Short-term trading.<br/>
It's what we do.</h1>
<p>Join <strong>125,000+ traders</strong> who have opened an account with Nadex.</p>

<p class="section-title text-center">Why Nadex?</p>
<div class="col-md-3 col-sm-6">
<div class="card text-center" id="card1">
<p><img alt="Trading Around the Clock" class="lazy" data-original="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_blue-active-markets.png" height="140" src="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_blue-active-markets.png" style="display: inline;" width="140"/></p>
<p class="title" id="title1">Trading Around the Clock</p>
<p class="description">23 hours a day, Sunday-Friday. Whenever you want to trade.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-md-3 col-sm-6">
<div class="card text-center" id="card2">
<p><img alt="Short-Term Contracts" class="lazy" data-original="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_blue-short-term-contracts.png" height="140" src="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_blue-short-term-contracts.png" style="display: inline;" width="140"/></p>
<p class="title" id="title2">Short-Term Contracts</p>
<p class="description">Trading intra-day, daily or weekly provides unique opportunities.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-md-3 col-sm-6">
<div class="card text-center" id="card3">
<p><img alt="Active Markets" class="lazy" data-original="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_blue-active-markets-v2.png" height="140" src="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_blue-active-markets-v2.png" style="display: inline;" width="140"/></p>
<p class="title" id="title3">Active Markets</p>
<p class="description">Small market movements offer opportunities.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-md-3 col-sm-6">
<div class="card text-center" id="card4">
<p><img alt="Risk That You Define" class="lazy" data-original="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_blue-controlled-risk.png" height="140" src="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_blue-controlled-risk.png" style="display: inline;" width="140"/></p>
<p class="title" id="title4">Controlled<br/>
Risk</p>
<p class="description">Know your maximum potential profit or loss up front.</p>
</div>
</div>

<div class="row interim-ways-trade">
<p class="section-title text-center">Three ways to trade.</p>
<div class="col-sm-4">
<div class="way" style="box-shadow: 7px 9px 46px 0px rgba(143,139,143,1);">
<p class="title text-center"><a href="/products/binary-options">Binary Options</a></p>
<p class="diagram" style="background-color:#fff;padding:15px 0;"><a href="/products/binary-options"><img alt="Nadex Binary Options" class="img-responsive lazy" data-original="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_blue-binary-options.png" height="165" src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABAQMAAAAl21bKAAAAA1BMVEUAAACnej3aAAAAAXRSTlMAQObYZgAAAApJREFUCNdjYAAAAAIAAeIhvDMAAAAASUVORK5CYII=" style="margin:0 auto;" width="165"/></a></p>
<p class="description" style="padding-bottom:44px;">Nadex Binary Options turn every trade into a simple question: will <i>this</i> market be above <i>this</i> price at <i>this</i> time.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-sm-4">
<div class="way" style="box-shadow: 7px 9px 46px 0px rgba(143,139,143,1);">
<p class="title text-center"><a href="/products/touch-brackets">Touch Bracket™ contracts</a></p>
<p class="diagram" style="background-color:#fff;padding:15px 0;"><a href="/products/touch-brackets"><img alt="Nadex Touch Brackets" class="img-responsive lazy" data-original="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_orange-touch-brackets.png" height="165" src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABAQMAAAAl21bKAAAAA1BMVEUAAACnej3aAAAAAXRSTlMAQObYZgAAAApJREFUCNdjYAAAAAIAAeIhvDMAAAAASUVORK5CYII=" style="margin:0 auto;" width="165"/></a></p>
<p class="description">A Nadex Touch Bracket has floor and ceiling "knockout" points. This structure can maximize effective leverage and provide natural profit targets.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-sm-4">
<div class="way" style="box-shadow: 7px 9px 46px 0px rgba(143,139,143,1);">
<p class="title text-center"><a href="/products/call-spreads">Call Spreads</a></p>
<p class="diagram" style="background-color:#fff;padding:15px 0;"><a href="/products/call-spreads"><img alt="Nadex Call Spreads" class="img-responsive lazy" data-original="https://www.nadex.com/sites/default/files/images/icon_green-call-spreads.png" height="165" src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABAQMAAAAl21bKAAAAA1BMVEUAAACnej3aAAAAAXRSTlMAQObYZgAAAApJREFUCNdjYAAAAAIAAeIhvDMAAAAASUVORK5CYII=" style="margin:0 auto;" width="165"/></a></p>
<p class="description">Nadex Call Spreads have a floor-to-ceiling trading range which offers defined risk without the need for stops, allowing time for the market to prove you right.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
